context: The two transaction lists are given in full in the input; no external data is needed. Group entries by their exact, case-sensitive reference value. Keep every reference that appears in either list, even when a side is absent or the net difference is zero. For each reference, bank_present is true if at least one bank entry has that reference, and ledger_present is true if at least one ledger entry has that reference; presence reflects entries, not net amount. bank_cents is the sum of the bank entry cents for the reference, ledger_cents is the sum of the ledger entry cents for the reference, and difference_cents is bank_cents minus ledger_cents. Order the records by reference using ordinary case-sensitive string ordering. total is the sum of the absolute values of all difference_cents values. Write the result to the given destination as a UTF-8 JSON file containing exactly an object with keys records and total, with object keys sorted, compact separators (comma and colon), ASCII escaping, and one final newline. The destination is a canonical relative .json path; existing files are never overwritten. Return the same records and total together with the destination path.
